A.q: 'Used to' describes repeated past actions, habits, and situations. It is followed by which verb form?
options: Base form of the verb
Past simple form
Present continuous form
Third person singular form
A.explain: 'Used to' is followed by the base form of the verb. It describes repeated past actions, habits, and situations; past simple, continuous, and third person singular are not the form after 'used to'.

A.q: Which form is used instead of 'used to' for single events?
options: Simple past form
Used to form
Present continuous form
Future form
A.explain: Single events use the simple past form. 'Used to' is for repeated actions or past states that are no longer true; present continuous and future are not past forms.

A.q: The negative form of 'used to' is which structure?
options: Didn't use to + base form
Didn't used to + past form
Don't use to + base form
Won't use to + base form
A.explain: The negative is 'didn't use to' plus the base form; 'use to' has no -ed. 'Didn't used to' plus a past form, 'don't use to' and 'won't use to' are incorrect.

A.q: Yes/No questions with 'used to' begin with which word?
options: Did
Do
Does
Will
A.explain: Yes/No questions use 'Did' + subject + 'use to' + base form. Short answers use 'did' or 'didn't'; 'do', 'does' and 'will' are not the question form.
